conversation.title: Meet a K-pop fan
conversation.goal: Say hello, share your favourite song, and ask about Mina’s to find something you both like.

turns.text: Hi, I’m Mina, and I love “Dynamite” by BTS! What’s your favourite K-pop song?
hi mina, my favourite is dynamite too because is fun
Hi! We both love “Dynamite”! Do you like dancing to it?
yes i dance in my room but i am bad haha. do you like dancing too?
Yes, I like dancing too, even when I miss a step! What part of “Dynamite” do you like dancing to most?
i like chorus most because is fun. but i forget steps haha
The chorus is fun! I forget the steps too, so I make up my own dance. Do you watch dance videos to learn the steps?
yes i watch dance videos but is too fast haha. do you know easy dance?
Those videos can be too fast! I like stepping left and right and clapping to “Dynamite.” Do you want to try that?
yes i can try haha. i like easy steps because i am not good dancer
Easy steps are fun, and you can enjoy the song while you learn! What other song would you choose for an easy dance?
maybe butter because i like it too. is dance easy?
“Butter” is fun too, but some steps are hard! If you made your own dance, what move would you put first?
maybe clap hands first because is easy haha. what move you like?
Clapping is a fun way to start! I like moving my shoulders to “Butter.” What would you call our new dance?
maybe butter dance haha because is easy name. was fun talking to you bye!
“Butter Dance” is a fun name for our easy steps! It was fun talking about BTS with you too, bye!

findings.suggested_acceptance: Preserve relevant topics, acceptance of typed replies, reciprocal responses, and natural endings.

judge.voice: i would use it again. talking about BTS was easy to start, and i actually wrote eight replies. i liked that Mina answered my questions and nobody made me use my voice. the two fixes made sense and didn't make me feel stupid. i still forgot “it” again though, so seeing the examples at the end would help. the last screen only told me how many replies and moments i had. most questions felt okay, but the one about making my own dance was harder. i trust those corrections; this chat doesn't tell me whether the level check is accurate. i can't tell from this whether the waits are worth it. i'd tell a friend it is a nice way to practise typing before trying voice chat.
